decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates under the ACT platform remain central to the firm's strategic push into glass-core packaging and high-frequency applications, a growing field, so management would keep developing them rather than withdraw them after two years.

VLIS laser-based through-glass-via structuring was just launched as a next-generation flagship complementing the ACT substrates, so the firm would keep investing in it to capture demand for advanced semiconductor packaging.
